detailZones.title: Gate lounge
detailZones.description: The seating rows face the wall clock, blank display, drinking fountain and waste bin.

detailZones.title: Boarding podium
detailZones.description: The counter, microphone, readers, glass gate and retractable belt occupy the gate lane.

detailZones.title: Gate floor and access lane
detailZones.description: The metal podium base and glass post foot stand beside the floor stripe and tile joint.

detailZones.title: Passenger boarding bridge
detailZones.description: The glazed corridor leads past its rail and threshold to the bellows and support wheel.

detailZones.title: Aircraft doorway and cabin
detailZones.description: The open aircraft door reveals the curtain, cabin windows, seats and overhead bins.

detailZones.title: Airside service edge
detailZones.description: The cone, wheel chock, ground equipment and marked pavement sit below the aircraft.

anchorAudit.rationale: The clock, readers, queue posts, bridge interior, aircraft doorway and ground equipment were located on the released photograph. Unresolved shelf functions, hidden podium mechanisms, distant cabin fittings and earlier operational exclusions have no map points.
